findings.statement: CA9 is the top convergence gene (rank 1, score 4.5197). In tumor scRNA-seq 54.7% of RCC cells express it and RCC holds 0.976 of tissue transcripts (cpm_share 0.958); it is tumor-intrinsic. Tumor cells vs proximal tubule: log2FC 7.739 (padj 0.0189, 6 donors). TCGA log2FC 9.712, and 7.787 at purity 1.

In Visium, RCC explains CA9 in situ (composition-corrected share 0.999); high-CA9 spots are surrounded by RCC (observed neighbor share 0.4757 vs expected 0.3654, padj 0.0017) and slightly by macrophages (log2 enrichment 0.099). The best MGD site (score 0.546, 126.8 A3, pocket pLDDT 90.3, one accessible lysine) is modest; the model mean pLDDT is 76.56 and ligand-site recall is 0.5 (0.221 in top pockets). This is a site ranking, not evidence that a glue exists.

CD70 ranks 3 (score 4.2143). TCGA log2FC is 7.09 and 4.278 at purity 1, so the signal is tumor-intrinsic in bulk; the ranking lists clinical-stage antibodies (cusatuzumab PHASE_2, vorsetuzumab PHASE_1). The Visium sections do not cover CD70, so there is no in situ context.

NNMT ranks 7 (score 3.9643): TCGA log2FC 4.685 and 5.256 at purity 1 (tumor-intrinsic). Adverse prognosis (TCGA Cox log HR 0.301, padj 0.00479). Antibody/small-molecule tractability is only predicted, no clinical drug, and DepMap shows no selective dependency (mean effect 0.316). No structural analysis is available.

EPAS1 transcripts in tumor scRNA-seq sit mostly in endothelium (81.3% expressing, 0.365 of transcripts, cpm_share 0.626) and fibroblasts (0.081 share); RCC cells express it in only 4.9% of cells (0.051 share). A bulk EPAS1 signal is therefore largely microenvironment, not a clean tumor-cell readout.

MET is tumor-cell dominated: RCC holds 0.935 of tumor transcripts (35.2% of cells expressing, cpm_share 0.682); endothelium has 12% expressing cells and 0.03 of transcripts. It is a tumor-cell target, with a minor endothelial component.

CD74 is an immune (antigen-presenting) gene: cDC 100% expressing (cpm_share 0.311), macrophages 99.5% expressing and 0.436 of tumor transcripts, CD8 T cells 0.345 of transcripts. It is not tumor-cell restricted.
CXCR4 is carried by infiltrating lymphocytes: CD8 T cells hold 0.563 of tumor transcripts (72.9% expressing), CD4 T cells 87.8% expressing (cpm_share 0.17). This is a microenvironment target.
ALDOB ranks 2 (score 4.2206) as a loss biomarker, not a target: TCGA log2FC -4.741 and -6.302 at purity 1; lower expression is linked to worse survival (Cox log HR -0.358, padj 0.000023).
SLC22A8 ranks 4 (score 4.1667) as a loss biomarker: TCGA log2FC -6.154 (-5.787 at purity 1), with a favourable Cox log HR of -0.402 for higher expression (padj 0.0000433).

SCARB1 ranks 5 (score 4.1052) with the highest target-profile score of the top five (4.1314): TCGA log2FC 3.989, 3.762 at purity 1; it has an Open Targets genetic-association score of 0.519 and no clinical drug.

COL23A1 is the top tumor-track first-in-class candidate (novelty 0.767): 7 ccRCC papers (43 total), no clinical drug, AB/PR tractable, surface or secreted. RCC holds 0.881 of tumor transcripts (17.1% of cells expressing); TCGA log2FC 5.829, 4.88 at purity 1; vital-organ max 3 nTPM (heart muscle). Its best MGD site is poor (score 0.2342, 8 A3, pLDDT 52.9, model mean 58.91), so it is not glue-tractable. No survival or DepMap dependency evidence.

RAB42 (tumor track, novelty 0.705): 2 ccRCC papers (20 total), no clinical drug, RCC holds 0.627 of tumor transcripts, TCGA log2FC 4.371 and 3.189 at purity 1, vital-organ max 2.6 nTPM (lung). Best MGD site scores 0.5348 (37.4 A3, pLDDT 88.8, 3 accessible lysines; model mean 85.31; no ligand-site validation). Hypothesis only, no functional evidence.

OLFML2A (stroma track, novelty 0.481): fibroblast-carried (0.647 of tumor transcripts), 2 ccRCC papers (27 total), no clinical drug, antibody-tractable; TCGA log2FC 2.372, 1.527 at purity 1. Colon expression is 27.9 nTPM, so off-tumor risk is not negligible. Stroma target, not a tumor-cell one.

JAG2 (stroma track, novelty 0.416) is endothelial (0.487 of tumor transcripts), 9 ccRCC papers (268 total), no clinical drug; TCGA log2FC 1.549, 1.061 at purity 1; Cox log HR -0.177; heart muscle 12.7 nTPM. Selective dependency not shown.

GAL3ST4 (immune track, novelty 0.64) is macrophage-carried (0.972 of tumor transcripts), with 1 ccRCC paper (17 total), no clinical drug and antibody tractability. TCGA log2FC 2.993, but only 0.401 at purity 1, so partly infiltration-linked; adverse prognosis (Cox log HR 0.177). Brain cortex 7.4 nTPM.

LILRB4 (immune track) is macrophage-carried (0.933 of transcripts), 7 ccRCC papers (340 total), no clinical drug. TCGA log2FC 3.7 falls to 0.508 at purity 1 and is flagged infiltration-driven (not purity-robust): it marks macrophage abundance, not tumor-cell expression.

GBP5 (immune track) is mainly CD8 T cell (0.573 of transcripts), 10 ccRCC papers (280 total), no clinical drug, flagged infiltration-driven (0.417 at purity 1) with adverse prognosis (Cox log HR 0.227). A T-cell activation marker rather than a drug target.

caveats: Discovery candidates are data-ranked hypotheses: no dependency or functional evidence, literature counted by gene symbol.
MGD scores rank sites only; no glue is claimed. Pockets of COL23A1 and RAB42 are tiny and RAB42 has no ligand-site validation.
Several genes (EGFR not queried, CD70 and NNMT without sc evidence ids) were covered only from ranking rows; scRNA-seq has few PT cells (39) and 5 donors for endothelium/fibroblasts.
